hints.title: Department Maxima
hints.text: Find the maximum salary in 'Engineering' and the maximum salary in 'Marketing' independently.

hints.title: Scalar Subqueries
hints.text: Use two subqueries to isolate maximum salary values for each required department.

hints.title: Absolute Difference
hints.text: Compute the absolute value of their difference and alias the result as salary_diff.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: N: number of employees in Salaries table
complexity.notes: Two filter scans finding maximum salaries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Cartesian join of all rows without aggregation generates N^2 pairs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use ABS and scalar subqueries or conditional aggregation.

solutions.approach: Pandas Filter Max and Absolute Difference
